metadata.question: Did Shanhai experience higher land surface temperature anomalies than Beijing during August 5-12, 2013 relative to the 2000-2012 average for that week?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS 8-day LST (MODIS/061/MOD11A2) for Aug 5–12, 2013 and the 2000–2012 baseline for the same day-of-year window (DOY 217–224). Fallback to Aqua LST (MODIS/061/MYD11A2) if Terra has no images. 2. Masking strategy: Mask with QC_Day bits 0–1 <= 1 (good/other quality). Convert LST to Celsius. 3. Logic: If image collections are empty -> C1. If after masking, valid pixel count is zero for any needed period/city -> C2. If computed anomalies are null/NaN -> C3. Otherwise compare Shanghai anomaly > Beijing anomaly -> A else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { try { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const beijing = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([115.8, 39.6, 117.5, 41.1], null, false); const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([121.0, 30.7, 121.9, 31.6], null, false); const start2013 = '2013-08-05'; const end2013 = '2013-08-13'; // end is exclusive const doyStart = 217; const doyEnd = 224; const scale = 1000; const maxPixels = 1e9; // Helper: evaluate a server object const evalAsync = (obj) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.evaluate((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)))); // Total pixel counts (sampling grid) per AOI async function getTotalPixels(aoi) { const total = ee.Image(1) .rename('const') .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }) .get('const'); return await evalAsync(total); } const totalPxBJ = await getTotalPixels(beijing); const totalPxSH = await getTotalPixels(shanghai); if (!totalPxBJ || !totalPxSH) { console.log('Total pixel count calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Masking for MOD11A2/MYD11A2 Daytime LST function maskMOD11A2(img) { const qc = img.select('QC_Day'); const qa = qc.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1 const mask = qa.lte(1); // good or other quality const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST'); return lstC.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()); } function getCol(product, start, end) { return ee.ImageCollection(product).filterDate(start, end).map(maskMOD11A2); } function getBaselineCol(product) { return ee.ImageCollection(product) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2000, 2012, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doyStart, doyEnd, 'day_of_year')) .map(maskMOD11A2); } async function pick2013Collection(aoi) { let usedProduct = null; let usedStart = start2013; let usedEnd = end2013; let col = getCol('MODIS/061/MOD11A2', usedStart, usedEnd); let size = await evalAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) { col = getCol('MODIS/061/MYD11A2', usedStart, usedEnd); size = await evalAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) { // widen by ±1 day usedStart = '2013-08-04'; usedEnd = '2013-08-14'; col = getCol('MODIS/061/MOD11A2', usedStart, usedEnd); size = await evalAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) { col = getCol('MODIS/061/MYD11A2', usedStart, usedEnd); size = await evalAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) { return { col: null, usedProduct: null, usedStart, usedEnd, size: 0 }; } else { usedProduct = 'MYD11A2'; } } else { usedProduct = 'MOD11A2'; } } else { usedProduct = 'MYD11A2'; } } else { usedProduct = 'MOD11A2'; } return { col, usedProduct, usedStart, usedEnd, size }; } async function pickBaselineCollection() { // Try Terra first; fallback to Aqua if Terra empty let col = getBaselineCol('MODIS/061/MOD11A2'); let size = await evalAsync(col.size()); let usedProduct = 'MOD11A2'; if (size === 0) { col = getBaselineCol('MODIS/061/MYD11A2'); size = await evalAsync(col.size()); if (size === 0) { return { col: null, usedProduct: null, size: 0 }; } else { usedProduct = 'MYD11A2'; } } return { col, usedProduct, size }; } async function computeCollectionStats(col, aoi, totalPx) { const fc = ee.FeatureCollection( col.map(function (img) { const mean = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('LST'); const count = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }).get('LST'); return ee.Feature(null, { meanC: mean, count: count }); }) ); const nImages = await evalAsync(col.size()); const validFc = fc.filter(ee.Filter.gt('count', 0)); const nValid = await evalAsync(validFc.size()); let meanOfMeans = null; let avgCount = null; if (nValid > 0) { meanOfMeans = await evalAsync(validFc.aggregate_mean('meanC')); avgCount = await evalAsync(validFc.aggregate_mean('count')); } const avgValidPct = avgCount && totalPx ? (avgCount / totalPx) * 100.0 : 0; return { nImages, nValid, meanOfMeans, avgCount, avgValidPct }; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const baselinePick = await pickBaselineCollection(); if (!baselinePick.col) { console.log('Baseline images: 0'); console.log('C1'); return; } const pick2013BJ = await pick2013Collection(beijing); const pick2013SH = await pick2013Collection(shanghai); if (!pick2013BJ.col || !pick2013SH.col) { console.log(`2013 images Beijing: ${pick2013BJ.size || 0}, Shanghai: ${pick2013SH.size || 0}`); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing and pixel count checks const stats2013BJ = await computeCollectionStats(pick2013BJ.col, beijing, totalPxBJ); const stats2013SH = await computeCollectionStats(pick2013SH.col, shanghai, totalPxSH); const statsBaseBJ = await computeCollectionStats(baselinePick.col, beijing, totalPxBJ); const statsBaseSH = await computeCollectionStats(baselinePick.col, shanghai, totalPxSH); if (stats2013BJ.nValid === 0 || stats2013SH.nValid === 0 || statsBaseBJ.nValid === 0 || statsBaseSH.nValid === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking in one or more periods/locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculation const mean2013BJ = stats2013BJ.meanOfMeans; const mean2013SH = stats2013SH.meanOfMeans; const meanBaseBJ = statsBaseBJ.meanOfMeans; const meanBaseSH = statsBaseSH.meanOfMeans; if ( mean2013BJ === null || mean2013SH === null || meanBaseBJ === null || meanBaseSH === null || !isFinite(mean2013BJ) || !isFinite(mean2013SH) || !isFinite(meanBaseBJ) || !isFinite(meanBaseSH) ) { console.log('Computation produced null/NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const anomBJ = mean2013BJ - meanBaseBJ; const anomSH = mean2013SH - meanBaseSH; const diff = anomSH - anomBJ; // 5. Output concise evidence (<=20 lines) console.log(`2013 Product BJ: ${pick2013BJ.usedProduct}, SH: ${pick2013SH.usedProduct}; Baseline: ${baselinePick.usedProduct}`); console.log(`Beijing 2013 imgs: ${stats2013BJ.nImages}, valid%: ${stats2013BJ.avgValidPct.toFixed(1)} (px≈${Math.round(stats2013BJ.avgCount || 0)}/${totalPxBJ})`); console.log(`Beijing base imgs: ${statsBaseBJ.nImages}, valid%: ${statsBaseBJ.avgValidPct.toFixed(1)} (avg px≈${Math.round(statsBaseBJ.avgCount || 0)}/${totalPxBJ})`); console.log(`Beijing mean LST: 2013=${mean2013BJ.toFixed(2)}°C, base=${meanBaseBJ.toFixed(2)}°C, anomaly=${anomBJ.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`Shanghai 2013 imgs: ${stats2013SH.nImages}, valid%: ${stats2013SH.avgValidPct.toFixed(1)} (px≈${Math.round(stats2013SH.avgCount || 0)}/${totalPxSH})`); console.log(`Shanghai base imgs: ${statsBaseSH.nImages}, valid%: ${statsBaseSH.avgValidPct.toFixed(1)} (avg px≈${Math.round(statsBaseSH.avgCount || 0)}/${totalPxSH})`); console.log(`Shanghai mean LST: 2013=${mean2013SH.toFixed(2)}°C, base=${meanBaseSH.toFixed(2)}°C, anomaly=${anomSH.toFixed(2)}°C`); console.log(`ΔAnomaly (SH - BJ): ${diff.toFixed(2)}°C`); // 6. Final Answer if (!isFinite(anomBJ) || !isFinite(anomSH)) { console.log('C3'); } else if (anomSH > anomBJ) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
